newsitem.title: KENYA: Kenya bourse index down in moderate trading.
newsitem.headline: Kenya bourse index down in moderate trading.

text.p: The Nairobi Stock Exchange (NSE) 20-share index fell on Tuesday as trading remained at low levels in a slow market, brokers said.
The index fell 6.12 points to stand at 3045.56. Turnover was posted at 15.872 million shillings on 506,453 shares compared to 5.120 million shillings on 152,061 shares on Monday.
Bourse officials said Tuesdays trading was moderate. Turnover was boosted however by two heavy lots dealt on the three-day special board for Car & General and Uchumi Supermarket.
Car & General traded 139,811 shares at 22.25 from the offer price of 23 shillings while foreign investors dealt 162,100 shares at 39 from 39.75.
Elsewhere foreign investors dealt 1,000 shares on Diamond Trust Bank, 6,000 shares of Firestone East Africa and 13,682, 2,900 shares of National Industrial Credit at 42 and 41 shillings respectively.
Brokers said that the market remains slow, with the few changes that are occuring appearing on the big lots being dealt from the special board and foreign investors board.
Among the plantations, Brooke Bond fell a shilling to 177, Rea Vipingo eased to 10.95 from 11 while Sasini Tea & Coffee was unchanged at 50.
Kenya Airways traded 59,841 shares at 9.90 from 9.85, Nation Printers & Publishers was steady at 106.
Housing Finance Company eased to 23.25 from 23.50, Standard Chartered Bank fell to 44 from 45. Oil concern Total Kenya remained unchanged at 72.
